title: Senior Product Manager - Growth
description: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own growth across acquisition and activation. You will run A/B testing and experimentation at scale, define success metrics and KPIs, partner closely with engineering, design and data science in a cross-functional team, and manage stakeholders up to the VP level. You have 5+ years of product management experience, are data-driven, have a track record of improving conversion rates and retention in a marketplace. Hybrid: 2 days per week in the office in Barcelona. We offer €85,000 - €105,000 gross per year, stock options, private health insurance, 25 days of holidays plus your birthday off, flexible hours, a learning budget and Wellhub. Spanish is a plus.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform
description: Fully remote within Spain. Own the roadmap and strategy for our generative AI platform: LLM evaluation, evals, prompt engineering, agents, model quality. Work with machine learning engineers. 6+ years in product management. Strong SQL. We offer equity, unlimited PTO, work from anywhere for 8 weeks, home office budget, pension plan, dental and mental health support. Salary: 95k-120k EUR.

title: Product Manager (French speaking)
description: Fluent French is required. On-site in our Barcelona office. Manage roadmap for B2B SaaS. 3 years experience. The company raised €40,000,000 in funding.
